avis.titre: It's a great pick if you're new to vitamin A skincare.
avis.texte: I've tried The INKEY List Retinol Serum as a gentle intro to retinol, and it's a great pick if you're new to vitamin A skincare. Many users find it lightweight and easy to layer without feeling greasy, and it absorbs nicely into the skin. _ It's designed to be mild enough to start just a couple nights a week, so you can build tolerance slowly without major irritation. _

Love love love it! Right after applying it, my lips look yummy, softer, and more hydrated. I also see a subtle plumping effect that makes my lips look naturally fuller and more defined perfect for an everyday lip routine. I love how easy it is to apply, and I've already added it to my daily routine both morning and night. My lips feel healthier and more nourished with each use.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way.
avis.texte: A little goes a long way. This retinol is light and does not irritate. You see a difference within the first few days. Has no color or strong Oder. Overall a good starting retinol for sensitive skin like mine.

Really impressed with this serum. It's gentle, didn't irritate my skin, and I noticed smoother texture after a couple of weeks. Easy to use, absorbs well, and works great in my routine. Perfect for anyone new to retinol!

This inkey list retinol for beginners is a fantastic serum if you are just starting out on retinol! It's gentle yet effective. I also use a moisturizer after applying to lock it in. I recommend! Super effective.

I was excited at the idea of trying a beginner retinol as I have never had luck with them and always experience irritation and breakouts. I had high hopes for this one but alas it didn't work out for me either. I will say this definitely is gentle, because I didn't experience irritation until the 5 or 6 usage! I started out using twice weekly then went to once a week but still experienced irritation so it's sadly not for me. But I definitely would recommend trying! Maybe your experience will be better.

I really like how gentle this serum feels. It goes on smoothly and doesn't sting or burn, especially even when my skin is a bit sensitive. After a couple of uses, I noticed my skin looked a bit smoother and more even. It seems to help with tiny fine lines around my eyes and forehead as they appear softer. The serum layers nicely under my moisturizer, and it doesn't feel heavy or sticky.

Great starter retinol serum, I've used since end of November twice per week. It works for my dry, sensitive skin. Did not irritate my face. Will continue to use it. So far my forehead looks more smooth than before.

avis.titre: Hyperpigmentation is already looking less visible
avis.texte: I have used this product twice so far. I believe you can see in these pictures that my hyperpigmentation is already looking less visible. The first time, I believe, I used too much and I experienced a little bit of dry skin. The second time, using the correct amount, I had no issues. After already noticing the results, I am so excited to continue to use this product.

This serum has a light creamy texture that spreads easily and absorbs well without leaving any residue. It feels gentle on my skin and I didn't experience any irritation or dryness while using it, which I appreciate since retinal can be strong. My skin looked a little smoother and more even by the end of the trial. It's a nice beginner option that feels calming and steady instead of harsh.

I used to be pretty skeptical about retinol, but after weighing all the pros and cons, I finally decided to give this serum a try. I apply it every other night, and I've been pleasantly surprised. The texture feels great on the skin, and there's absolutely no discomfort, no burning, no peeling, no redness.What I did notice, though, was a real improvement in my skin's appearance. Fine lines started to smooth out, and my skin looks more elastic and youthful. The only downside I experienced was a few breakouts, but I've read that this is a normal and common reaction when your pores start to purge and your skin begins a faster regeneration process. And honestly, after a couple of weeks, the breakouts started to disappear.So yes, there might be a few temporary inconveniences, but if the result is glowing, smoother, younger-looking skin, it's absolutely worth it.

This nighttime retinol serum was a gift from Inkey, and I really enjoy using it. I feel a slight change in my skin; I only use it twice a week, but it's effective, and the results show quickly. I like the ingredients, the size of the bottle, and how easy it is to apply and how it feels on my skin. I recommend it.

avis.titre: Easy for me to start a retinol routine
avis.texte: I really liked this retinol serum! It made it easy for me to start a retinol routine and I felt like it was more gentle than other products I've tried. I think it's another great product from The Inkey List.

This is a gentle, beginner-friendly retinol that smooths fine lines and improves texture without irritating my skin. I have sensitive skin, so I really appreciated how calming it felt while still being effective. It's fragrance-free, vegan, and clinically tested, which made me feel confident using it.
